_comment: Harbor AgentConfig fragment for Codex; eval/scripts/run.py merges it into a job.
Auth: CODEX_FORCE_AUTH_JSON uploads ~/.codex/auth.json (ChatGPT login) into the sandbox,
so no OPENAI_API_KEY is needed. Set CODEX_AUTH_JSON_PATH for another file.
host_env is exported into the `harbor run` process (see claude-code.json for why).
version matches the CLI preinstalled in verifier/shared/Dockerfile.
multi_agent stays off: Harbor builds the trajectory from the newest rollout, and a
subagent's rollout would replace the main one.
name: codex
